positions.description:
- Led end-to-end design and launch of Earnings Hub in Coinbase Wallet, surfacing creator rewards, fee rewards, and staking earnings with real-time animations, privacy mode, and social sharing

projects.title: BitLE
projects.description:
AngelHack 2014 Project
Bitcoin Mobile Payment using Bluetooth Low Energy Devices
Bridging the gab between bitcoin owners and merchants. We want to see bitcoin being used every day life. Our solution is to allow merchants to accept bitcoin as method of payment and customers to come in and order away using our Android App.

projects.title: inQueue
projects.description:
inQueue is a project designed to help minimize wait times. It puts users on a virtual queue so that they can spend their time elsewhere while still being considered in line. For now, we've geared this towards restaurants but would like to eventually extend this to any situation where customers find themselves waiting in line. 

We've designed the front-end using the Android API and the back-end using node.js to store data in the cloud on Amazon Web Services. This idea will be used to form a startup company for the UT entrepreneurial class durng both Fall 2013 and Spring 2014.

patents.title: Techniques for Granular Licensing
patents.description: Techniques and architectures for granular licensing in a computing environment having access to an app exchange that provides a listing of multiple apps available to a remote client electronic device in response to a download request. A registration request corresponding to a software package having multiple modules is received. A license definition is transmitted from the management entity. The license definition includes a license for one or more of the multiple modules. The software package and license definition are registered with the management entity, so that only authorized management entities can store license definitions or grant licenses. The license definitions are stored in a memory associated with the management entity. One or more licenses are transmitted to a client electronic device. The one or more licenses correspond to one or more of the multiple modules of the software package that the client electronic device is authorized to utilize. The client electronic device is capable of acquiring the software package from the app exchange. The one or more licenses are capable of authorizing the client electronic device to utilize the one or more licensed modules.
